items.heading: Bazin
details: Key ingredients: barley flour, water, lamb, tomato sauce, egg
Knead barley flour with hot water into a firm dough ball.
Simmer lamb in a spiced tomato sauce until tender.
Mold the dough into a dome in the center of a serving plate.
Surround it with the sauce, meat and boiled eggs.

items.heading: Sharba Libiya
details: Key ingredients: lamb, chickpeas, tomato, mint, orzo
Simmer lamb pieces with chickpeas and tomato until tender.
Season with mint, cinnamon and turmeric.
Add small orzo pasta and cook until soft.
Finish with fresh mint and a squeeze of lemon.
